entries.text: New game in the playground: Whose Shadow? One of our real 3D toys turns slowly as a dark shadow on a little stage; tap the friend it belongs to and the lights come on. Eight rounds, three picture choices at first and then four, no fail screen: after two wrong taps the right friend wiggles as a hint. Tested on a phone-size screen with zero page errors, in English and Vietnamese. The new Gingerbread Buddy also joined Hide and Seek and Toy Bowling.

New figure for the Christmas season: the Gingerbread Buddy, a chubby gingerbread cookie friend of our own design with white icing trim, three gumdrop buttons and a knitted scarf, sculpted in Sculpt Studio v2. Why now: Google Trends interest in gingerbread Christmas ornaments climbed from 9 in October to a peak of 74 in December last year (Accio trend report), and a mini gingerbread figure set on MakerWorld has 64 comments and ratings, so demand should build over the next 4-8 weeks. The body is one solid piece (watertight, 0 bad edges, one shell, 62 x 35 x 70 mm) and all five colour parts passed the closed-surface check. It also joins Hide and Seek and Toy Bowling as a new toy.

Sharper 3D previews for the sculpted figures: the viewer now loads a clean preview mesh per colour with smooth shading, colour borders are softened, and the first four animals were re-sculpted at 160-cubed resolution. Print files are unchanged in shape and still pass the closed-surface check.

Four more figures sculpted in Sculpt Studio v2 at 160-cubed resolution: a fox cub, a grinning frog, an axolotl and a tabby kitten, all original designs shaped with the same brushes the app offers (clay blobs, Pinch for ear tips, Dam Standard for smiles, Smooth along every limb). While making them we found and fixed a brush bug that left faint ridges where clay blobs overlapped, and re-sculpted the first four animals with the fix. All eight bodies and every colour part passed the closed-surface check.

New figure set made with our own Sculpt Studio, the in-browser clay app that just launched: a chick, a bunny, a bear cub and a penguin, all original designs. Each comes as one solid STL plus a colour-split 3MF where the colour regions tile the body exactly, so a multi-colour print has no gaps and no loose parts. All four bodies and every colour part passed the closed-surface check after a position-weld test, the same way slicers read them.

Batch 2 is live, picked from market research instead of guesswork. Gridfinity storage is searched about 90,000 times a month and grew 76% in two years, so a free Gridfinity starter set brings people in. Christmas decor is the strongest seasonal seller on Etsy from November, so a four-piece flat ornament set is today's featured paid model. Print-in-place flexi animals sell year-round; the Flexi Fishbone lands just before Halloween. An AirTag collar holder covers the pet-accessory demand. All four passed the closed-surface check; the fishbone has eight separate shells, one per moving segment, so no joint is fused.
Shop opened with six printable models across four lines: two desk organizers, a print-in-place fidget, two decor pieces and a four-part multi-colour whale.
Every file is checked before it is listed: closed surfaces, one shell per part, size and volume recorded. Six of six passed with zero open edges.
Payments are not connected yet. Buy and membership buttons walk through the checkout in demo mode, and free models download for real.
Next drop is scheduled for tomorrow at 09:00 (Vietnam time). The rotation runs functional, print-in-place, decor, then figure, so every line gets a new model each week.
